clues: Centuries of observation here have contributed to the study of ice sheets and climate.
A fast-moving glacier delivers ice from a great ice sheet towards the sea.
Calving fills a fjord with icebergs, linking inland ice movement to the marine environment.
The protected fjord lies on Greenland’s western coast, north of the Arctic Circle.
Find the Greenlandic World Heritage icefjord at the sea mouth of the glacier known as Sermeq Kujalleq.
targetLabel: Ilulissat Icefjord — designated property reference point
modernContext: UNESCO’s published representative point for the designated property, not its uniquely correct centre.
explanation: The mystery follows ice from an ice sheet through an outlet glacier into a fjord. Rapidly changing annual discharge figures from the source are omitted rather than presented as current measurements. The target is the published property reference point, not the moving calving front.
